qualification: Written before subgroup effect models and IFN extraction; the previously reported aggregate B-cell result was already known. This is an analysis plan, not external preregistration.
source: GSE174188 locally archived remapped processed count matrix and original cg_cov/ct_cov metadata; not raw droplet or new cell-level QC.
batch_selection: Reuse exactly the existing 233 individual/batch selections; largest total processed source cells among cohorts 2/3/4, lexical tie break. No selection by B abundance or IFN.
annotation: Use original ct_cov exactly among cg_cov=B. Other labels, missing and coarse/fine discordance remain a separately quantified residual. Plasma cells in cg_cov=PB are a different coarse compartment, not included. No IFN-derived state labels.
primary_composition: Fraction of each state among all source cg_cov=B cells, with zero numerators retained, in individuals with at least 20 total B cells.
secondary_composition: State fractions among all source PBMC cells in the full 233-person selection.
state_IFN: Per-cell mean of the 12 log1p(count/library*10000) gene values, then mean over source-recorded state cells within each selected individual; at least 20 target-state cells per individual.
model: OLS: outcome ~ C(cohort) + Age10 + C(Sex) + C(pop_cov) + C(condition), condition HD as reference; HC3 covariance, independent observations are source individuals.
fit_eligibility: At least 10 eligible individuals in each arm, full-rank design, residual degrees of freedom >=10 and finite positive HC3 disease standard error. No endpoint-dependent eligibility.

multiple_testing.state_composition_within_B: BH across the three planned source-recorded states.
multiple_testing.state_IFN: BH across the same three planned states; any unestimable planned test is represented by P=1 for adjustment and reported unavailable.
multiple_testing.state_composition_all_PBMC: Separate BH family of three secondary state fractions.
multiple_testing.matched_B_population: Separate BH family of two endpoints: overall B fraction and aggregate B IFN in the same >=20-B-cell individuals.
multiple_testing.common_state_population: Separate BH family across all eligible source-recorded states × two endpoints (within-B fraction and state IFN), in the intersection of their >=20-state-cell individuals, if >=10 individuals remain in each arm.
multiple_testing.mixture_adjusted_IFN: One exploratory aggregate B-IFN model, adding the three named state fractions with the residual state omitted; cannot establish cell-intrinsic activation.
multiple_testing.marker_panel: Descriptive review only; no marker-test P values or labels trained using IFN.
multiple_testing.cohort4_state_sensitivity: Separate BH across three states × two endpoints, planned unavailable tests represented by P=1.
multiple_testing.status_consistent_state_sensitivity: Separate BH across three states × two endpoints, planned unavailable tests represented by P=1.

sensitivity: Within-source sensitivity analyses overlap the original cohort and are not independent replication. Main published model estimates will not be overwritten. State-level IFN and within-B fractions will additionally be fitted in selected processing cohort 4 and after excluding individuals whose source-recorded Status varies across batches; these are separate sensitivity families.
limitations: Observational source-recorded states; subtype proportions and IFN differences need not distinguish intrinsic expression from unmeasured states, treatment, disease activity or residual technical effects.
